evidence.reason: The condition at line 1030 only checks `status !== 'ok'` and `!known`, but `report.units` rows carry `report` whenever `collected` has evidence (L1017), independent of the final result status, and L1020-1022 already include that unit's real tasks. Thus a unit whose job result is replaced (e.g. `budget-exhausted`) after it returned `ok` is both counted in `report.tasks` and inserted into `unstartedUnits`, creating a false never-started row and inflating planned/unresolved counts and the PR "Unfixed" section. The guard should also require `row.report === undefined`.
